latest_release.name: Agent Skills 0.6.15
latest_release.body:
Agent Skills 0.6.15 stops the security skill's staged-secret check from printing the secret it finds, fixes two simplify-ignore bugs that could corrupt protected code, and makes the constraints skill's security and accessibility gates actually fail CI.

## Security

- **The staged-secret check no longer echoes credentials** (#718, @santhiprakash, reported by @xmxxc in #717). The old `git diff --cached | grep` printed every matching line, so a staged key landed in the terminal and in any agent's transcript. It also read as clean when git failed. The check is now `git diff --cached -i -G'…' --name-only`: it prints only file names, and a git failure exits non-zero by itself. Fixed in all three places it was documented.

## Hooks

- **simplify-ignore restores re-indented placeholders cleanly** (#766, @Quinnod345, #765). If `/code-simplify` un-indented a placeholder or edited its reason, Stop wrote back a broken comment around the block, a syntax error in any `/* */` language. Blocks marked with `-- simplify-ignore-start` (SQL, Lua, Haskell) no longer warn that they were deleted, and a missing lock directory no longer stops Stop before every file is restored.

## Skills

- **Quality gates that fail when they should** (#694, @mavericksea-ai, #693). Semgrep and axe exit 0 even with blocking findings, so the constraints skill's examples could pass CI while breaking the written bar. The skill now ships a small report gate that blocks high and critical findings, and it says to run each enforced command against a deliberate violation before calling it enforced.
- **Contrast thresholds corrected** (#733, @CybotTM): large text is 18pt (24px) or 14pt bold, not 18px.
- One-line gotchas from @CybotTM: compact well before the host's context limit, which varies by host (#739); keep a contradicting caller or guard in the doubt review unit (#754); and an injected exception isn't a crash, and a mocked transaction isn't a rollback (#750).
- git-workflow-and-versioning fires on a pasted diff (#758), and security-and-hardening names session cookies in its description (#759), both @ayobamiseun as part of #620.
- The shipping error boundary types its `children` prop (#683, @rudycelekli).

## Evals

- `--eval <id>` runs a single behavioral case (#742, @CybotTM).
- The runner names any positive prompt that passes `top_k` without ranking first (#760), and the plugin-eval graders no longer expect command names that #714 removed, with the re-run recorded (#756), both @ayobamiseun.

## Thanks

Thanks to everyone who contributed and reviewed this release: @santhiprakash, @xmxxc, @Quinnod345, @mavericksea-ai, @CybotTM, @ayobamiseun, @rudycelekli and @federicobartoli.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/compare/0.6.14...0.6.15
